# Rajesh Gheware

> Chief Architect, AI & DevOps consultant and GenAI / Agentic AI trainer (5,000+ professionals trained). Author of books on Kubernetes (CKA) and Agentic AI. Also a trekker and ultra-distance cyclist based in Bengaluru, India.

- [Portfolio](https://rajeshgheware.github.io/): experience, AI projects, training catalog, publications, contact
- [Training](https://devops.gheware.com): Agentic AI, GenAI, Kubernetes, DevOps corporate training

## Treks

Trek guides with the same structured facts on every page (distance, difficulty, season, permits, transport from Bengaluru). All data as JSON: [treks/index.json]({{ site.url }}/treks/index.json). Index: [treks]({{ site.url }}/treks/).
